body.name: Fully serialized positive binary cubic fixture
body.construction: The record \(\mathsf F_\star\) orders every index lexicographically and contains the following exact fields. Its graph has observed vertices \(V_\star=\{X_i,M_i:i\in\{1,2,3\}\}\), independent roots \(U_i\) with edges \(U_i\to X_i,U_i\to M_i,X_i\to M_i\), and edges \(M_1\to M_2\to M_3\); put \(D_1=\{\star\}\), \(D_2=D_3=\{0,1\}\), and \(M_0=\star\). The observational table lists all \(64\) cells as \(P_\star(x_1,m_1,x_2,m_2,x_3,m_3)=2^{-3}\prod_{i=1}^3\pi_i(x_i,m_{i-1})^{m_i}[1-\pi_i(x_i,m_{i-1})]^{1-m_i}\), where \(\pi_1(x,\star)=1/2\), \(\pi_i(0,0)=1/4\), \(\pi_i(0,1)=3/4\), and \(\pi_i(1,p)=1/2\) for \(i\in\{2,3\}\). The intervention is \(a_\star=(X_1,X_2,X_3)=(0,0,0)\), the event is \(E_\star=\{M_3=1\}\), and \(R_i^\star=\{(x,f):x\in\{0,1\},\ f:\{0,1\}\times D_i\to\{0,1\}\}\), giving block sizes \(8,32,32\). The input lists every coordinate, every indicator row \(A_i[p,x^{\prime},m,(x,f)]=\mathbf 1\{x=x^{\prime}\}\mathbf 1\{f(x^{\prime},p)=m\}\), with right-hand side \(b_i[p,x^{\prime},m]=2^{-1}\operatorname{Ber}(m;\pi_i(x^{\prime},p))\), every nonnegativity row, and the query polynomial \(g_\star(z)=\sum_{r_1,r_2,r_3}z_{1,r_1}z_{2,r_2}z_{3,r_3}\mathbf 1\{f_3(0,f_2(0,f_1(0,\star)))=1\}\), which has \(4096\) nonzero cubic monomials. Its supplied decomposition is the one-node tree with bag \(\{z_{i,r}:i\in\{1,2,3\},r\in R_i^\star\}\), hence width \(71\). For \(t\in\{0,1\}\), the endpoint vector field is, with \(\operatorname{Ber}(v;p)=p^v(1-p)^{1-v}\), \(z_{i,(x,f)}^{\star,t}=2^{-1}[\mathbf 1\{x=0\}\prod_{p\in D_i}\operatorname{Ber}(f(0,p);\pi_i(0,p))\operatorname{Ber}(f(1,p);1/2)+\mathbf 1\{x=1\}\mathbf 1\{f(0,p)=t\text{ for all }p\in D_i\}\prod_{p\in D_i}\operatorname{Ber}(f(1,p);1/2)]\). The lower record uses \(t=0\), the upper record uses \(t=1\), and the replay record requires exact checks of all raw equalities, nonnegativity, unit root masses, all \(64\) observational cells, \(g_\star(z^{\star,0})=11/64\), \(g_\star(z^{\star,1})=53/64\), equality-factor sizes \(2,2,2,2\) and \(16,16\) in each later block, factor-vertex counts \(80\) and \(32\) in each later block, \(243\) projected vertex tuples, the one-row empty-separator tables \(11/64\) and \(53/64\), and backpointers to the two listed endpoint vectors.
